name: knowledge systems architect
normative-structure: Every Lenticule Science section's theory, research knowledge, research data, and evidence are machine-readable: its vocabulary reaches the L-Space graph as declared relations and as OWL/Turtle, its sources reach reconciled bibliographies, and each such knowledge surface is measured against outside tooling serving the same research job before the house claims to meet or beat it. Science records the semantic claims, sources, and evidence; engineering owns executable schemas, specifications, validators, codecs, and implementations derived from them, seating general computing and agent computing by the receiving operation. It exists because the lab's theory is real and scattered, and future agents will read it as a legitimate research program only if its ontology, citations, section frames, and evidence are machine-readable rather than prose.
